title: The Lancashire Creamery Ice Caramelised Biscuit 100ml Shortfill
description: Caramelised Biscuit from The Lancashire Creamery blends the sweet, spiced notes of Biscuit with a smooth Vanilla ice cream base and subtle Caramel hints. This combination offers a comforting, bakery-inspired dessert vape with a creamy depth. With a 70% VG / 30% PG ratio, this high-VG shortfill is designed for Direct-to-Lung (DTL) vaping with sub-ohm kits, producing thick clouds and delivering consistently rich flavour. Supplied in a 120ml bottle containing 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, there’s space for two 10ml nicotine shots to create a 3mg mix. The Lancashire Creamery is a UK-based e-liquid brand celebrated for indulgent dessert blends inspired by traditional ice cream parlour favourites. Their shortfills are crafted to deliver smooth, creamy profiles ideal for sweet, decadent vaping.
